dishes.name: Antalya piyazı
dishes.desc: White beans in a thick tahini, garlic and lemon dressing with egg and onion. It is a main dish here, not a side salad, and carries a geographical indication.

dishes.name: Antalya şiş köfte
dishes.desc: Lamb-heavy minced meat pressed onto skewers and grilled. In Antalya it is the standard partner of tahini piyaz, eaten with flatbread.

dishes.name: Hibeş
dishes.desc: A thick tahini, garlic and lemon spread served as a meze or dip, closely tied to Antalya's tahini cooking. Scoop it up with bread alongside piyaz.

dishes.name: Alanya tava
dishes.desc: Lamb cooked with tomatoes, peppers and garlic in a pan or clay dish until thick and savoury. A home-style dish of the Alanya coast.
